sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I've got an hour before lunch with my friend.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'd love to make her a card with her favourite bird.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: At the museum desk, I show the worker a workshop photo.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, could I make a card like this?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Oh, that's from our bird print workshop.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I saw an eleven o'clock class on your website.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That one's full, but we've got space at one.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I'll be at lunch then, so I can't stay.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: We've got a drop-in table if you've only got a little time.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Oh, I skipped that part of the page.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: It's under Try It Yourself.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Do I need to book for the drop-in table?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: No, you can start right now.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: It says materials included.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Does that cover an envelope too?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yep, the paper, ink and envelopes are all on the table.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, I'll give it a try.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I pay, and the worker shows me to the table.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: There's the stamp with the blue bird.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Press it onto the paper like this.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Oh, look at that little line under its feet.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's a branch. You can add leaves with this stamp.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I'll just add one leaf so there's room to write.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Leave it on this rack while the ink dries.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I've got to leave before noon.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: It'll be dry in ten minutes if you leave it flat on the rack.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, how long should I leave it there?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Ten minutes on the rack.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Perfect, I've still got twenty minutes.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: While it dries, I write her name on the envelope.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: It's dry now, so I can put it in here.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: At lunch, I hand my friend the card.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: She props it up by her plate.
